info.title: v2.media_space.upload_video_part
info.description: Upload video file by part using the upload_id in initiate_video_upload. The request Content-Type of this API should be of multipart/form-data

post.description: Upload video file by part using the upload_id in initiate_video_upload. The request Content-Type of this API should be of multipart/form-data

parameters.name: part_content
parameters.description: The content of this part of file. Part size should be exactly 4MB, except last part of file.

parameters.name: part_seq
parameters.description: Sequence of the current part, starts from 0

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: video_upload_id
parameters.description: The video_upload_id in the response of initiate_video_upload

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/media_space/upload_video_part?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => array('part_content'=> new CURLFILE('/path/to/file') /* Replace with actual file path */),
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

curl --location --request POST 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/media_space/upload_video_part?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp' \
--form 'part_content=@"/path/to/file"'  #replace the sample path with your file path
